mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in simultaneous HOUST and RSAFS expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in UNRATE > 5.0% and declining UNRATE periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production reflects robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rising INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts fall below 2000 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that dampens consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in HOUST < 2000 periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and elevated CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and rising FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In slowing GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0%), a positive surprise in GDP (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 0.5%) signals economic rebound that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0% and GDPC1 quarterly growth > 0.5%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in slowing GDP growth regimes with positive GDP surprise are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
